column1: # Fault-code wording of our own, for the codes SAE J2012 defines.
# Three tab-separated columns: the code, then Ukrainian, then Russian. The
# text is written from what the standard code means, not translated from any
# manufacturer's phrasing, so nothing in this file is derived from SDD. The
# English a user sees still comes from the loaded library; these two columns
# are what the interface shows when it is set to Ukrainian or Russian, and
# the original English stays beside them and in every report.
# Only codes the standard defines belong here — the generic ranges P0, P2,
# P34-P39, U0, B0, C0. A manufacturer-specific code's wording is the
# manufacturer's text and is never carried in this repository.
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Codes must be unique and sorted.
